description: PersonMerger locks supplied participants and relations, snapshots original history, computes all final state and validates before writes; owner API apply ordering removes duplicates, transfers references, deletes losers, persists complete survivor once. People outer resource transaction merges first and applies ordinary edits once to returned survivor; remove resource_edits and helper dispatch. Migration discovers/sorts groups, private small singleton fold if needed. Tests precede implementation; preserve contracts/concurrency/immutable migration snapshots. Document only resulting ownership/semantics.
title: [zaq-0cg] Refactor private group calculation and People merge-then-edit orchestration
